capitol-hill-parks.note: Unresolved. Capitol Hill Parks is a management grouping of small federal reservations that trace to the original plan of Washington; NPS cites the Residence Act of July 16, 1790 (1 Stat. 130) as their origin. No action designating 'Capitol Hill Parks' as such was found. The reservations passed to the Interior Department with the other National Capital parks under Executive Order 6166 (effective Aug. 10, 1933).

chesapeake-bay.note: Unresolved. 'Chesapeake Bay' is the NPS Chesapeake Bay office and program, not a park unit. Its main program authority is the Chesapeake Bay Initiative Act of 1998 (Public Law 105-312, title V), which created the Chesapeake Bay Gateways and Watertrails Network; that act did not establish a unit named Chesapeake Bay.

civil-war-defenses-of-washington.note: Unresolved. Civil War Defenses of Washington is an interpretive grouping of fort sites held in several NPS units (National Capital Parks-East, Rock Creek Park, George Washington Memorial Parkway). Many were acquired under the Capper-Cramton Act of 1930, but no action establishing the grouping itself was found.
